title: mcncarl/jianying-headless
why_read: A headless automation tool for Jianying (a Chinese video editing app), niche utility for automating video editing pipelines.
analysis: This repository provides headless, private-source tooling for driving Jianying (CapCut's Chinese counterpart) drafts programmatically, enabling isolated editing and export plus an 'Agent Skill' integration. It's a narrow, application-specific automation tool likely useful mainly to people building video content pipelines around this particular editor. The description is thin and doesn't reveal much about implementation quality or robustness.
